meta.title: Frequently asked questions — Mobilcab
meta.description: Straight answers about Mobilcab: installing, pricing, the Basic plan, and the product roadmap.

hero.label: Frequently asked questions
hero.title: Straight answers, before you sign up.
hero.body: If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us. We answer personally.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
a: No. Mobilcab runs straight from your browser, on a laptop. Nothing to install, no license server.

items.q: Does it work on tablet or phone?
a: Not yet — it's built for laptop. Tablet and phone optimization come later.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
a: The cut list (dimensions, quantities, materials) is the workshop foundation.
Dedicated CNC machine export comes later on the Roadmap — after nesting is solid. It is not included in the Basic plan at paid launch.

They're the stages on the Roadmap page, in order. M1 = Cut list (3D design + parts list — the foundation now, free). M2 = nesting, labels and quotes — when subscriptions open (FP: 20% off). M3 = CNC export. M4 = team and sharing. M5 = AI + renders.
Elsewhere on the site we talk about subscriptions and paid launch, not M-codes.
The app is free for now — full design and cut list, with no export limits — and we are not charging subscriptions. If you want 20% off the Basic plan, join the Founding Partner waitlist.

When we open subscriptions (the paid Basic plan: design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes), Free gets 3 downloads per account; people on the FP waitlist get 20% off list (6 months from first payment). Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. You are not obliged to pay if you do not want to. List amounts are announced at paid launch.

items.q: How is the Free plan different from Basic?
a: Now: Free is full on M1 — 3D design, cut list, exports and cloud save, with no download limits.

When subscriptions open, Free gets 3 downloads per account. Basic is the workshop plan: design, cut lists, nesting, labels and quotes, with unlimited exports. Founding Partners on the waitlist: 20% off for 6 months; later: list price.
after: We do not charge until the paid Basic plan opens. List prices are confirmed then.
